text: Finally, the prophet Elijah bears witness that he saw:
“The angel of the Lord showed me,” he says, “a deep valley called Gehenna, burning with sulfur and pitch.”
And in that place are many souls of sinners, and they are tortured there with various punishments:
Some suffer while hanging by their genitals [meaning uncertain]; others by their tongues, some by their eyes, and others hang upside down,
and women are tormented at their breasts, young men hang by their hands; some virgins are burned on a gridiron, and some souls are fixed in everlasting punishment.
Through these various punishments, each person's deeds are shown:
those who suffer pain in their genitals are certainly adulterers and pederasts;
those who are hung by their tongues are blasphemers and also false witnesses;
those whose eyes are burned are people who were led into sin by what they saw, looking lustfully at shameful deeds;
those who hung upside down are people who hated God's justice, gave corrupt counsel, and did not agree with their brother; therefore they are rightly burned under the sentence of punishment;

for the women who are commanded to be tormented at their breasts are those who gave their bodies to men in lewdness; therefore the men too will be near them in torments, hanging by their hands because of this.
